blurb: Displaced ViscoSpaceDrum kick clusters that never land on a straight four — four different sgubhu cells rotate over 4 cycles, 808 ghost hats pan-drift on a slow sine, ply fills punctuate every 8 bars. Dark Durban club pressure.

blurb: Deep 808 take on the broken-kick brief: a 3-3-2 kick cell walks around the bar via iter(8) so the displacement itself slowly rotates, pitched-down lt toms answer, micro-late hats add drag swing. Heavier and slower-feeling than the Visco sibling.

blurb: 808 maracas in a {3}%4 polymeter that realigns every 3 cycles, riding the pump idiom so on-beat hits duck under the kick. Full adds a Visco hat layer in 5-against-8 with masked breathing; peak throws pitched-up cowbells into the weave with 8-bar double-time fills.

tags: gqom toms percussion euclid rotating reich polyrhythm tribal dark hypnotic sa-club durban visco drums
blurb: Reichian gqom tom engine: lt and mt play euclid(3,8) cells whose rotation offsets walk in opposite directions over 4 cycles while their pans breathe on opposite-phase sine/cosine sweeps. Peak adds a 5,8 mid layer and masked high-tom fills.

tags: gqom darbuka framedrum hand-drum organic percussion euclid rotating world tribal hypnotic agogo sa-club acoustic
blurb: Organic sibling of the Visco tom engine: vcsl darbuka and framedrum trade euclid cells whose rotations walk opposite directions, sample-index alternation keeps every hit slightly different. Peak sprinkles a masked agogo bell walking its own offsets. Gqom meets hand percussion.
